verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a first-party Radar product ("Bot & Fraud Protection", "Protect your app from bots, fraud, and abuse") that applies to its auth flows. The evidence for it is only one-line marketing and pricing mentions. It is separately metered per check rather than clearly built in, and nothing specifically addresses credential stuffing or brute-force defenses. missing for 10: explicit credential-stuffing and brute-force protections (e.g., lockout, rate limiting on login), in-depth docs on how Radar detects and blocks attacks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
